summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, furnishing a management information circular for an annual and special meeting to approve a court-approved plan of arrangement to simplify its corporate structure with Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. under one publicly traded company, Brookfield Corporation Ltd. No financial terms are disclosed in this filing. The board recommends voting in favor of the transaction. The filing is a routine proxy circular related to a corporate simplification; it is not a classic special situation like an acquisition or going-private.
